gl:definition.gl:content: passport issued as the output of a transformation event by an actor accredited for the regulated claims it contains, hash-linking its input passports

gl:notes.gl:content: Only accredited actors may issue derived passports for regulated claims (the notified-actor pattern of EN 18239).
Children of a split carry a derived-from reference and quantity carve-outs, with the sum of children not exceeding the parent (remainder semantics).
